name: QSC_PROD_GRP_ATTR_B
description: This table is used to store further narrow by options available to a product group. Narrow by filters can be used to further filter the search results based on certain attributes. The attributes on which narrow by filters can be defined could be item attributes, pricing attributes, shipping attributes and/or tag attributes.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Product Group Further Narrow By Attribute Identifier

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier used for integration with external systems.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Persistent Id used to reference the original version.

columns.name: REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Revision Number

columns.name: CHANGE_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used internally for publishing product groups.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier. Foreign Key to QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_OPTION_ID
columns.description: Refers to the product group attribute option unique identifier.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Manually set display order in which narrow by attributes are displayed at runtime.

columns.name: NARROW_BY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the attribute will be displayed in the narrow by section at runtime.

columns.name: DISPLAY_PROD_LAYOUT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this attribute should be displayed in the product list or detail layout for a particular product group.

columns.name: ADVANCE_SEARCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the attribute will be available for advance search.

columns.name: SHOW_ALL_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the attribute will be displayed in the 'Show All' part of the narrow by region at runtime.

columns.name: SORT_BY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether attribute will be available for sorting.

columns.name: DOMAIN_AUTO_GEN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the domain is automatically generated for this attribute type.

columns.name: UI_MODE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the mode in which UI should be rendered during runtime.

columns.name: ATTR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the type of attribute.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
